scope: final exhaustive QA + approval reconciliation + Git synchronization; no build; no VR/FFB; no GPT Library
zero_pixel_rule: localized nontransparent bbox including outline/shadow/glow/alpha fringe must be a subset of canonical source text bbox and must remain inside the declared sprite cell; any 1 px escape is FAIL_REWORK_REQUIRED

method.same_size: direct decode current canonical HD source DDS and current candidate DDS; source/candidate alpha>0 bbox per declared text element; RGBA32 raw payload or DXT5 decoded pixels
method.create_new_hd: source alpha bbox scaled to candidate coordinates; current candidate rescanned; outside-cell evidence accepted only when current SHA equals prior pixel-diff report SHA
method.orientation: readable/game bbox and transformed raw DDS bbox both recorded

inputs.latest_A: A89 D6DC1380 production plus prior A78-A88 current candidate lineage
inputs.latest_B: B90 D6DC1380/48DEBE77 plus prior B79-B89 current candidate lineage
inputs.prior_C: C83 and earlier C75-C82 static QA reports
inputs.prior_D: D85 and earlier final static reconciliation reports

approval_reconciliation.reason_no_new_promotion: ORIENTATION_POLICY requires isolated DDS_ONLY in-game screenshot validation before final promotion; current branch has no such pass evidence for these candidates.
approval_reconciliation.removed_reason: Historical approved binaries are low-resolution 512x64 RGBA32 versus canonical HD 2048x256 DXT5, and their current HD replacements also FAIL the new exact source-bbox zero-pixel gate.
